title: Market Observation Record
$comment: Market Reality Data Layer V1. A structured time-series measurement from an authoritative public source -- production, acreage, yield, price, shipment volume, or trade flow. Deliberately NOT a Publication and NOT Evidence: no analyst review step, no fact/claim distinction. Trust here means 'sourced from a named authoritative statistical agency with a preserved methodology reference,' not 'analyst-approved.' Immutable once written: create() rejects a duplicate id, and id is derived from (source, source_dataset, metric, source_commodity_code, geography, period, captured_at) -- a later re-fetch of the same logical series gets a NEW id (new captured_at), never overwrites a prior capture. Revision detection compares the new value against the most recent prior captured_at for the same logical key and reports a difference; it never deletes or edits the earlier record.

berry_id.$comment: Normalized link to data/entities/berries/*.json, e.g. 'berry-strawberry'. Null when the source commodity category spans multiple berries or a non-berry crop and cannot be honestly collapsed to one -- see source_commodity_label/source_commodity_code for the real, preserved category. Never guess a single berry for a mixed category.

source_commodity_label.$comment: Verbatim source-provided commodity label, e.g. 'Strawberries' or 'Berries (excluding strawberries)'. Always preserved even when berry_id is set.

source_commodity_code.$comment: Verbatim source-provided commodity/crop code, e.g. Eurostat crop code 'S0000', or an HS code for trade data. Preserved for traceability regardless of normalization.

geography.$comment: Verbatim source geography code, e.g. Eurostat 'ES' or 'EU27_2020'. Always preserved even when geography_id is set.

geography_id.$comment: Normalized link to data/entities/geographies/*.json when the source geography maps to exactly one real country/region entity. Null for supranational aggregates (e.g. 'EU27_2020') or any geography without an existing entity -- never invent a geography entity here.

period.$comment: Source-native period label, e.g. '2025' (year) or '2025-06' (month). Not reformatted.

unit.$comment: Verbatim source unit, e.g. '1000 t', '1000 ha', 't/ha', 'USD/kg'. Never converted or normalized -- unit conversion across sources is a real, separate hazard this V1 does not attempt.

source.$comment: Short source identifier, e.g. 'eurostat'. See docs/v2/MARKET-REALITY-DATA-LAYER-V1.md for the full licensing/attribution note per source.

source_dataset.$comment: Source's own dataset/table code, e.g. 'apro_cpsh1', for exact reproducibility.

methodology_reference.$comment: Short pointer to the source's own methodology note, where available. Not a full legal/statistical review.

captured_at.$comment: When Berry Intelligence OS retrieved this value -- distinct from 'period' (when the measurement itself covers). Drives revision detection.

berry_ids.$comment: Graph-connection field for entity linking (mirrors the berry_ids convention used elsewhere), populated identically to [berry_id] when berry_id is set, else empty.

geography_ids.$comment: Graph-connection field, populated identically to [geography_id] when set, else empty.
